title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Set up the core database for the secondhand bookshop, import legacy CSV stock lists, verify ISBN integrity, integrate with a third-party pricing API, and set up an automated reorder notification system.
latestMessage: Set up the core database for the secondhand bookshop, import legacy CSV stock lists, verify ISBN integrity, integrate with a third-party pricing API, and set up an automated reorder notification system.

steps.title: Database Schema Design and Setup
steps.instruction: Create a PostgreSQL database schema containing tables for Books (including fields for ISBN, Title, Author, Condition, and Stock Quantity), Categories, and Transactions.
steps.acceptance: Database is successfully initialized on the development environment and schema can be queried with standard SQL.
steps.result: Schema has been successfully generated and applied to the database instance. Tables for books, categories, and transactions have been verified with primary and foreign key constraints. Test records inserted successfully.

steps.title: CSV Stock Import Script
steps.instruction: Develop a Python migration script to parse legacy CSV files containing secondhand book stock and populate the database. Handle encoding errors and empty fields safely.
steps.acceptance: Script processes a 10,000-line sample CSV file without throwing errors, correctly populating the database.
steps.result: Completed script execution on sample data. Handled UTF-8 and ISO-8859-1 encoding anomalies. Successfully imported 10,230 book records into the database with default stock values for missing fields.

steps.title: ISBN Validation and Formatting Service
steps.instruction: Write a helper library to validate and standardize ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 inputs, removing hyphens and recalculating checksums where necessary.
steps.acceptance: Standardized outputs for various input formats must pass unit tests including edge cases with X checksums.
steps.result: Implemented and tested the validation helper. All 45 unit tests passed, confirming correct extraction and transformation of malformed ISBN numbers into standard ISBN-13 formats.

steps.title: Third-Party Pricing API Integration
steps.instruction: Connect the inventory system to the OpenBookPricing API to fetch market values for incoming secondhand books based on ISBN.
steps.acceptance: System queries the external API and updates the local suggested_price field on book creation.
steps.result: Integration blocked. The external OpenBookPricing API service returned 401 Unauthorized errors even with valid development credentials, and their support portal indicates a service outage on the sandbox environment. Cannot proceed until the sandbox is restored.

steps.title: Automated Reorder Notification Engine
steps.instruction: Implement a Cron job and mail service that triggers automated email alerts to store managers when stock for popular titles falls below a threshold.
steps.acceptance: Email triggers whenever stock count is decremented below the threshold value, logged appropriately.
steps.result: Action blocked. SMTP mail relay configuration requires an active OAuth2 token from the bookstore's centralized authentication provider, which has not yet been provisioned for this environment. Request for credentials is currently pending approval from the IT security team.
